Everything about any object, printed and drawn

Source: R/wildcards.R
overview.Rd

overview() takes any object the package returns and shows all of it: the summary, the diagnostic checks and every plot the object can draw.

  • A profile, class or transition fit: report() (summary, descriptives, checks, every plot view).

  • Any other fit (mixture regression, growth mixture, general transition, additive, cross-level, pooled): its summary, its diagnostics() checks where defined, and plot_all().

  • An enumeration grid: its summary and plot_all() (criteria, entropy, AvePP, smallest class, BIC changes, trust, tree).

  • A comparison, bootstrap test, sensitivity analysis or diagnostics result: the object printed and its plot.

Usage

overview(x, plots = TRUE)

Arguments

x

Any object returned by the package.

plots

TRUE (the default) draws the plots; FALSE prints only.

Value

x, invisibly. Called for its printed and drawn output.

An object the package did not return raises latents_not_a_fit.

See also

report(), plot_all(), get_checks().

Examples

fit <- mixture_regression(score ~ hours, data = study_hours, n_classes = 2,
                          n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
overview(fit, plots = FALSE)
